attempts.code:

mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]

pick(mug["name"], grasp_height, yaw)

# Place the mug on the orange_tray with small offset to center it
place(tray["name"], dx=0.0, dy=0.0)

# Release the mug
release()

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
purple_box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]

# Check if purple_box is occupied
box_center = purple_box["center"]
box_half_size = purple_box["half_size"]
occupied = False
for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if obj_name == "yellow_mug":
        continue
    dx = abs(obj["center"][0] - box_center[0])
    dy = abs(obj["center"][1] - box_center[1])
    if dx < box_half_size[0] and dy < box_half_size[1]:
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Move the occupying object to a free zone
    free_zone = "cyan_tray" if obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]["center"] != box_center else "orange_tray"
    obs = observe()
    for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
        if obj_name == "yellow_mug":
            continue
        if abs(obj["center"][0] - box_center[0]) < box_half_size[0] and abs(obj["center"][1] - box_center[1]) < box_half_size[1]:
            grasp_height = obj["height"] / 2
            yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"]
            pick(obj_name, grasp_height, yaw)
            place(free_zone)
            break

# Now place yellow_mug in purple_box
grasp_height = mug["height"] / 2
yaw = mug["long_axis_yaw"]
pick("yellow_mug", grasp_height, yaw)
place("purple_box")
obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
box_center = purple_box["center"]
box_half_size = purple_box["half_size"]
assert abs(mug["center"][0] - box_center[0]) < box_half_size[0] and abs(mug["center"][1] - box_center[1]) < box_half_size[1], "Mug not fully inside purple_box"

goals.evidence: Put the yellow mug in the purple box.

constraints: The yellow mug must be moved from the orange_tray to the purple_box.
The purple_box must be accessible and unoccupied before placing the yellow_mug inside.
If the purple_box is occupied, the occupying object must be moved first.
The robot must confirm the yellow_mug is successfully placed inside the purple_box.
task_spec.refined_instruction: Move the yellow mug from the orange_tray to the purple_box. Before placing the mug, verify that the purple_box is unoccupied. If it is occupied, first move the occupying object to a valid free zone (e.g., cyan_tray or orange_tray, whichever is available). After placing the yellow mug in the purple_box, confirm that the mug is fully inside and no part of it is outside the box. Success is achieved when the yellow mug is securely placed within the purple_box and the robot reports the task as complete.
